name: Weazel's Crater
summary: Saltstone basilisks now sun themselves in the deep hollow of Weazel's Crater, while its origins remain unknown.

sections.title: A Volatile Legacy
sections.body: Weazel's Crater cuts deep into the northern Shimmering Flats. Experimental goblin and gnome rocket-cars still race across the blinding salt, pushing mechanical limits. Scorched earth, debris, and impact hollows mark the plain, but none match the crater's size and depth. No one knows what formed it. The wreckage has largely settled, and aggressive Saltstone basilisks now sun themselves in the hollow.

aliases: why is there a crater here
faq.answer: No one knows what caused Weazel's Crater. Its origins remain unexplained.

faq.q: What lives in the crater now?
faq.answer: Dangerous Saltstone basilisks inhabit the crater, lurking along its rocky edges and bottom.

angles.text: Weazel's Crater lies amid experimental racing machines and debris in the Shimmering Flats. As an engineer visiting the speedway, you have reason to study its hazardous terrain.
